name: @awebai/pi
description: Aweb for Pi: real-time channel awakenings, aw CLI onboarding, and aweb skills.

scripts.sync-skills: rm -rf skills && mkdir -p skills && cp -R ../skills/aweb-coordination ../skills/aweb-messaging ../skills/aweb-team-membership ../skills/aweb-bootstrap ../skills/aweb-identity skills/
scripts.build: npm run sync-skills && rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npx esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --external:@awebai/aw
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run test:package
